```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Read the raw data

```{r}
por <- read.csv("student-por.csv", sep = ";")
dim(por)
```

## keep only the variables we use

we use study time (`studytime`, categories 1 to 4) and final grade (`G3`, 0 to 20).
categories 1 and 2 (under 5 hours a week) are grouped as Lower, and 3 and 4 (5 or more hours) as higher

```{r}
por_clean <- por %>%
  select(studytime, G3) %>%
  mutate(study_group = case_when(
    studytime %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Lower",
    studytime %in% c(3, 4) ~ "Higher"
  ))

dim(por_clean)
por_clean %>% count(studytime)
por_clean %>% filter(G3 == 0) %>% count(study_group)
```
## Save the clean data

```{r}
write.csv(por_clean, "por_clean.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
